next_question.rationale: The largest funnel gap is between created -> confirmed (lost 87,511, share_of_prev 0.3862; created->confirmed conversion 0.6138 from phase1). Phase1 reason clusters show a large count of user-side system terminations ("abandoned by system": 54015; user_total: 90419), which suggests the drop may be concentrated in particular trigger types (e.g., on-demand vs scheduled). consultation_trigger is a rate-bearing dimension we have not yet tried; cutting by it will tell us whether specific trigger types convert materially worse and therefore where to focus remediation. If a trigger shows much lower confirm rate, confirm via a targeted A/B test (e.g., change availability messaging or queue handling for that trigger and measure created->confirmed conversion uplift).
